description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Last Stand] and [Haste], grants [Awoken Magika] to the user

description.name: Awoken Magika
description.text: White Magic and Bard abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x3.00 for White Magic and Bard abilities, casts Magika Cantus after using a White Magic or Bard ability

description.name: Magika Cantus
description.text: Restores HP (10/15/25/35/45) at rank 1/2/3/4/5 of the triggering ability, damages undead

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle
